answer: Each identity must catalog a relic garden: the beacon emits a shale pulse each epoch, and the agent must plant a unique lagoon signature. The first layer costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent layer doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at layer 12 (20.4 M iterations). A lagoon audit verifies each deposit against the epoch seed; any barren plot voids the chain. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full garden cost because each signature binds to the unique identity key—no work sharing possible.
